name: oracle-ai-data-platform-agent-builder
description: Build contract-defined AIDP custom agents for a shared UI, CLI and chat.

interface.shortDescription: Build process-capable agents for shared UI, CLI and chat
interface.longDescription: Generate high-code AIDP custom agents from English business component contracts. Package typed actions, fixed Python tools, reasoning nodes and native workflow state with a reusable A2App UI and CLI. Experimental native A2A runtime capabilities must be verified on the selected compute.
defaultPrompt: Build an AIDP agent with a dashboard and a business review process.
Refine a component contract in my existing AIDP agent.
